cases.rule: GWAS plus an analyzed eQTL, mQTL, pQTL, or other molecular layer may satisfy multi-omics across cohorts.
Colocalization supports a shared locus but is not a standalone exposure-outcome identification design.
Randomization identifies treatment assignment effects, not molecular direct or indirect effects without mediation assumptions.
Pre/post or observational mediation without temporal ordering and mediator-outcome confounding control is Level 2.
Trial, placebo, or treatment-arm wording does not establish randomized allocation unless randomization is explicit.
Routine baseline, follow-up, or pre/post measurement does not add temporal_design when intervention assignment supplies the contrast.
A directed network edge without an intervention, temporal anchor, estimand, or identification argument is not an identified effect.
Multiple assays, cohorts, or tissues from one molecular layer do not automatically establish multi-omics.
Missing decisive detail is unclear, not negative evidence.
